title: DecoMine: A Compilation-based Graph Pattern Mining System with Pattern Decomposition
abstract: Graph pattern mining (GPM) is an important application that identifies structures from graphs. Despite the recent progress, the performance gap between the state-of-the-art GPM systems and an efficient algorithm—pattern decomposition—is still at least an order of magnitude. This paper clears the fundamental obstacles of adopting pattern decomposition to a GPM system.
